source_text: Randomized controlled trials in sub-Saharan Africa, including those by Auvert et al. (2005) and Bailey et al. (2007), established that voluntary medical male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition in men by 51-60%, a protective effect sustained over 2-6 years of follow-up. [64] [65]
